key_claims.claim: Abdominal ectopic pregnancy is strongly associated with IVF conception and can be distinguished from tubal ectopic by specific ultrasound criteria including empty uterus, absent adnexal mass, and extrauterine gestational sac surrounded by bowel
Prenatal ultrasound findings in closed spinal dysraphism correlate with postnatal motor and bladder function at 18 and 36 months across a spectrum of lesion types
A multivariable model combining multiple sagittal aortic-arch parameters outperforms any single fetal echo measure for prenatal coarctation diagnosis
Bosniak v2019 classification predicts malignancy in class III-IV cystic renal masses, but correlation with unfavorable histology varies by subclass and nodule size
Multimodal AI integrating clinical, ECG, echo, CT, and lab data predicts long-term mortality after TAVI better than any single data modality
